cac:ProcurementProject.cbc:Name: Development of Training Courses for the European Raw Materials Sector
cac:ProcurementProject.cbc:Description: Development of Training Courses for the European Raw Materials Sector
cac:ProcurementProject.cbc:Note:
#Bekanntmachungs-ID: CXP4DM2MVHK#
Tenderers must declare that there is no connection to the Russian Federation within the meaning of Article 5k(1) of Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, as amended by Article 1(16) of Council Regulation (EU) 2025/2032 of 23 October 2025. The form Declaration of non-existence of grounds for exclusion must be used for the declaration.

efac:SelectionCriteria.cbc:Description: Registration with the commercial register (Indication of the HRB/HRA number and the register court): If there is no obligation to register (e.g. due to the legal form), corresponding information must be provided. Or a registration with a professional or trade register in other EU Member States (For the Member States of the European Union, the respective professional or trade registers are set out in Annex 11 to Directive 2014/24/EU).

Evidence must be provided of business liability insurance for activities that are the subject of the tendered contract, including the maximum amount of coverage in Euro per event per insurance. Declarations shall be made by using the form "Declaration of Eligibility".

Annual turnover in EUR (net), based on the last three completed financial years before the time limit for tenders, for which figures are already available. Declarations shall be made by using the form "Declaration of Eligibility".

Tenderers have to declare which parts of the contract the tenderer intends to subcontract, where such a declaration is already possible. Declarations shall be made by using the form "Declaration of Eligibility".

Tenderers have to declare which accreditations, quality marks or recognitions relevant to training development and delivery (awarding body, scope, validity) and describe their experience obtaining course- or programme-level accreditation, including the bodies involved and the outcomes. Declarations shall be made by using the form "Declaration of Eligibility".

Declaration showing the tenderer's average annual number of permanent employees over the last three calendar years before the time limit for tenders. Declarations shall be made by using the form "Declaration of Eligibility".

Work examples: Tenderers shall make proof of suitable experience in the form of a self-declaration in a list of the main supplies and services delivered or performed (work examples) over the last three years before the deadline for the submission of tenders.Each of the following criteria has to be met through at least one work example (exclusion criteria): The tenderer must demonstrate that it has experience of designing and developing training courses or modules whose content is comparable to the subject matter of the contract being put out to tender in this lot. Tenderers are requested to address the above-mentioned exclusion criteria in the description of the respective work examample if these are considered to be met by the tenderer. Declarations shall be made by using the form "Declaration of Eligibility".

cac:PaymentTerms.cbc:Note: - Fixed price for the development and supply of course material in accordance with Section 2.2 of the Statement of Work. - Fixed price covering the first-year review and update cycle, capped at a maximum of 10% of the course development price (lot 4: two cycles with a cap of 5 % of the course development price).

cac:SpecificTendererRequirement.cbc:Description: Section 56 Procurement Ordinance shall apply to follow-up requests for documentation.

cac:SubordinateAwardingCriterion.cbc:Name: Financial Offer
cac:SubordinateAwardingCriterion.cbc:Description: The financial offer will be rated on the basis of the total of all price items as set out in the price list. For more details please refer to section 8.1 of the Invitation to Tender

cac:SubordinateAwardingCriterion.cbc:Name: Technical and Functional Proposal
cac:SubordinateAwardingCriterion.cbc:Description: The quality will be assessed applying the following 8 sub-criteria: (1) Alignment with skill gap in section 2.1 SoW (2) Audience identification and demand justification as defined in section 2.2.1 SoW (3) Technical content quality and instructional design quality in section 2.2.2 SoW (4) SCORM/Tool selection in section 2.2.2 SoW (5) Certification proposal defined in section 2.2.6 SoW (6) Accessibility and inclusive programme design and incorporation of gender dimension as defined in section 2.2.2 and 2.2.4 SoW (7) Proposed valuation design (Kirkpatrick L2 = 5 vs. Kirkpatrick L2+L3 = 10) as defined in section 2.2.2 SoW (8) Team For more details and weightings of each sub-criterion please refer to section 8.1 of the Invitation to Tender.

cac:PresentationPeriod.cbc:Description: According to section 160 (3) sentence 1 No 4 ARC a review procedure is inadmissible, if more than 15 calendar days have expired since receipt of notification from the contracting authority that it is unwilling to redress the objection.

efac:SelectionCriteria.cbc:Description: Registration with the commercial register (Indication of the HRB/HRA number and the register court): If there is no obligation to register (e.g. due to the legal form), corresponding information must be provided. Or a registration with a professional or trade register in other EU Member States (For the Member States of the European Union, the respective professional or trade registers are set out in Annex 11 to Directive 2014/24/EU).

Evidence must be provided of business liability insurance for activities that are the subject of the tendered contract, including the maximum amount of coverage in Euro per event per insurance. Declarations shall be made by using the form "Declaration of Eligibility".

Annual turnover in EUR (net), based on the last three completed financial years before the time limit for tenders, for which figures are already available. Declarations shall be made by using the form "Declaration of Eligibility".

Tenderers have to declare which parts of the contract the tenderer intends to subcontract, where such a declaration is already possible. Declarations shall be made by using the form "Declaration of Eligibility".

Tenderers have to declare which accreditations, quality marks or recognitions relevant to training development and delivery (awarding body, scope, validity) and describe their experience obtaining course- or programme-level accreditation, including the bodies involved and the outcomes. Declarations shall be made by using the form "Declaration of Eligibility".

Declaration showing the tenderer's average annual number of permanent employees over the last three calendar years before the time limit for tenders. Declarations shall be made by using the form "Declaration of Eligibility".

Work examples: Tenderers shall make proof of suitable experience in the form of a self-declaration in a list of the main supplies and services delivered or performed (work examples) over the last three years before the deadline for the submission of tenders.Each of the following criteria has to be met through at least one work example (exclusion criteria): The tenderer must demonstrate that it has experience of designing and developing training courses or modules whose content is comparable to the subject matter of the contract being put out to tender in this lot. Tenderers are requested to address the above-mentioned exclusion criteria in the description of the respective work examample if these are considered to be met by the tenderer. Declarations shall be made by using the form "Declaration of Eligibility".

cac:PaymentTerms.cbc:Note: - Fixed price for the development and supply of course material in accordance with Section 2.2 of the Statement of Work. - Fixed price covering the first-year review and update cycle, capped at a maximum of 10% of the course development price (lot 4: two cycles with a cap of 5 % of the course development price).
